entries.text: Publish refused: This machine could not reach GitHub to check it is up to date. What to do: Check the internet connection and run the publish again.

Publish refused: GitHub refused the check that this machine is up to date (not a network problem: sign-in, remote address or repository). What to do: Run git fetch origin main by hand, fix what it reports, then publish again.
